tickerText: [TENNIS] Rafael Jodar rallied from a set down with a bagel to send Spain into the Davis Cup semifinals in Bologna as Alexander Zverev and Lorenzo Musetti also won their group ties • [SQUASH] PSA Platinum Hong Kong Open starts November 30 with defending men's champ Mostafa Asal, Paul Coll and World No. 1 Amina Orfi leading 64-player fields at Edinburgh Place • [BADMINTON] BWF locked Hangzhou World Tour Finals qualifiers after Hong Kong and awarded Worlds 2027 to Mississauga while greenlighting 24-team league formats from 2027 • [PICKLEBALL] The Opendoor Pickleball World Championships drew a record 70,000 fans and $2M in ticket revenue as Anna Leigh Waters notched her 46th PPA Triple Crown • [TABLE TENNIS] Muscat champion Shunsuke Togami, Honoka Hashimoto and Japan swept Star Contender titles before Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha took Hong Kong Finals mixed-doubles wildcards for Kai Tak December 9–13

newsItems.title: Opendoor Sets Records
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 Opendoor Pickleball World Championships in Farmers Branch drew 70,000 attendees and $2 million in ticket and registration revenue, with Waters claiming a 46th career PPA Triple Crown.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Draw Loaded
newsItems.excerpt: The Milwaukee Hong Kong Squash Open runs November 30–December 6 with 64 players across three venues; Asal chases a fourth title and Orfi returns as women's world No. 1.

newsItems.title: Wildcards for Wang/Sun
newsItems.excerpt: Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha received the lone mixed-doubles wildcard for WTT Finals Hong Kong at Kai Tak Arena December 9–13 after Muscat winners Togami and Hashimoto clinched the last singles berths.

newsItems.title: Jodar Lifts Spain
newsItems.excerpt: Rafael Jodar overturned a 2–6 opening set with a 6–0 second set to beat Jurij Rodionov and put Spain into the Davis Cup semifinals in Bologna; Zverev dismissed Arthur Fery 6–3, 6–2 in the same group.
